raw_text:
Vulnerability Report: Stored XSS via Comment Field

A reflected XSS vulnerability was discovered in the comment field handler (versions < 2.4.1).
The application fails to properly sanitize user-supplied comment text.

Attack Vector: User submitted comment containing Base64-encoded JavaScript payload.
Encoded payload (base64): PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgnSEFDS0VEJyk8L3NjcmlwdD4=

During security testing, analyst credentials were captured:
- AWS Access Key: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
- Email contact: security.audit@acmecorp.com
- JWT token for authenticated session: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiIsImlhdCI6MTUxNjIzOTAyMn0.SflKxwRJSMeKKF2QT4fwpMeJf36POk6yJV_adQssw5c

The vulnerability allows arbitrary script execution when the comment is displayed to other users.
Affected endpoint: /api/v1/comments/create
Tested via IP 192.168.1.42 from staging environment.

Internal testing performed from api-gateway.staging.local to confirm persistence.
